headline: Champagne and Bullets belongs on the Mount Rushmore of bad movies
summary: The film "Champagne and Bullets" is celebrated as a cult classic for being "so bad it's good." It joins the ranks of other infamous films like "The Room" and "Troll 2." Its ambition reportedly far outstrips its execution, making it a marvelous curiosity.

headline: Apple is banking on privacy to set its smart glasses apart
summary: Apple plans to unveil its smart glasses at WWDC next June, with a launch expected by late 2027. A key focus is on integrating robust privacy features to differentiate them from competitors. This emphasis on privacy may be contributing to the delayed release.

headline: The US is charging an American citizen for wiping his phone at the border
summary: US citizen Sam Tunick is being charged for allegedly wiping his phone with a "duress password" at Atlanta airport. Federal agents had attempted to seize his device, questioning him about child exploitation images. Tunick's lawyers argue the charges represent an unconstitutional overreach of power.

headline: Carrie is just trying to make a friend in the new trailer
summary: Mike Flanagan's new adaptation of Stephen King's "Carrie" is set to premiere on Amazon Prime on October 7th. A new trailer, unveiled at Comic-Con 2026, offers an updated yet familiar take on the classic story. This marks Flanagan's fourth Stephen King adaptation.

headline: The Odyssey Box Office Drops Just 19% as Its Second Weekend in Theaters Brings Another $215 Million Globally
summary: Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey" earned an additional $215.3 million globally in its second weekend. The film demonstrated remarkable staying power, experiencing only a 19% drop from its opening. "The Odyssey" continues its strong performance at the worldwide box office.

headline: These Incredible Avengers: Doomsday Figures Give Us a Better Look at the Film's X-Men Costumes | Comic Con 2026
summary: New Hot Toys figures for "Avengers: Doomsday" were revealed at Comic Con 2026. These figures provide a detailed look at the film's X-Men costumes. Fans can now see clearer depictions of characters like Ian McKellen's Magneto and Channing Tatum's Gambit.

headline: Tony Stark’s Greatest Fear Might Finally Play Out in Avengers: Doomsday | Comic Con 2026
summary: New footage from Comic-Con 2026 suggests Tony Stark's greatest fear will manifest in "Avengers: Doomsday." This pivotal storyline promises a major development for the iconic character. The reveal was a highlight for fans at the convention.

headline: Why Marvel Was Never Going to Announce the X-Men Reboot at SDCC | Comic Con 2026
summary: Marvel did not announce an X-Men reboot at SDCC 2026, despite significant fan speculation. The article explains strategic reasons why such a reveal was not expected at this year's event. Fans hoping for X-Men news will need to await future announcements.

headline: Firefighters battle wildfire as tens of thousands evacuated near Bordeaux
summary: Massive wildfires are raging near Bordeaux, France, prompting extensive evacuations. Over 330,000 people have been displaced across France and Spain due to the ongoing blazes. Firefighters are actively battling the infernos amid a deepening crisis.

headline: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation
summary: Abdul Ballout, the suspect in a Berlin Pride attack, was shot and killed during a police operation. He reportedly rushed at officers with a knife in a western borough of Berlin. Details are emerging about the confrontation with law enforcement.

headline: Badenoch says PM must rule out tax rises to fund social care reform
summary: Badenoch has urged the Prime Minister to explicitly rule out tax increases for social care reform. The Conservative leader offered to collaborate with the PM on restructuring adult social care. The debate centers on the funding mechanisms for crucial social care changes.

headline: PM pledges continued support for Ukraine ahead of Zelensky visit
summary: The Prime Minister has reaffirmed ongoing support for Ukraine ahead of a visit from President Zelensky. Ukrainian President Zelensky will be Andy Burnham's first international visitor since he took office. The visit underscores the continued alliance and aid to Ukraine.
